note: Germany records the name rule in scripts/market-links.ts would attach to the catalogue page of a different robot: another body (a stationary or wheeled upper body on a legged humanoid's page, a biped on a wheeled robot's page) or another size class. Each keeps its own /market page. Checked by hand against the record and the catalogue page. Versions with the same body stay on the robot's page, also wheel-legged quadrupeds such as the A2-W, which keep their legs.

separate.magiclab-magicbot-d1: Wheeled industrial robot; the catalogue MagicBot is a 1.38 m legged humanoid.
separate.dobot-atom-d: Stationary upper body; the catalogue Atom is a 1.53 m humanoid.
separate.dobot-atom-d-edu: Upper body on a wheeled base; the catalogue Atom is a 1.53 m humanoid.
separate.pndbotics-adam-u: Stationary upper body on a stand; Adam is a 1.67 m humanoid.
separate.unitree-r1-a: Stationary dual-arm upper body; the R1 is a 1.23 m legged humanoid.
separate.unitree-r1-a-d: Dual-arm upper body on a wheeled base; the R1 is a 1.23 m legged humanoid.
separate.unitree-h2-d-flagship: Upper body on a lifting column and wheeled base; the H2 is a 1.82 m legged humanoid.
separate.kepler-k2-all-runner: Upper body on an AGV wheel base; the Forerunner K2 is a 1.75 m legged humanoid.
separate.leju-kuavo-5-w: Upper body on a wheeled base; the Kuavo 5 is a biped.
separate.humanoid-hmnd-01-alpha-bipedal: 1.79 m, 90 kg biped; the catalogue HMND 01 Alpha is the 2.2 m, 300 kg wheeled robot.
separate.agibot-d1-max: 41 kg wheel-footed quadruped; the D1 Ultra is a 15 kg robot dog.
separate.agibot-d1-max-pro: 68 kg heavy-load quadruped; the D1 Ultra is a 15 kg robot dog.
